tracking.title: Set up Posti tracking codes
tracking.description: Posti tracking needs no account — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `posti.track_parcel` service.

account.title: Set up OmaPosti account
account.description: Posti no longer accepts a password, so you sign in with strong authentication (your bank or Mobiilivarmenne) in your own browser. Home Assistant then registers itself as a trusted device of your OmaPosti account and keeps that device's key, which renews the login without your bank. Anyone who can read your Home Assistant configuration or backups can use it; remove the device in the OmaPosti app to revoke it. Choose how you sign in.

reauth_confirm.title: OmaPosti needs a new sign-in
reauth_confirm.description: Posti no longer accepts the stored login {account}. Sign in again with strong authentication.

authenticate.title: Authenticate with Posti
authenticate.description: Open [this address]({address}) in your browser and authenticate. When you are done, copy the full address from your browser's address bar and paste it below. Keep it to yourself: it signs in to your account once.

error.invalid_auth: Posti did not accept the authentication. Start again and paste the address your browser ended on right after authenticating.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the OmaPosti account service.
error.invalid_return_address: That is not the address Posti returns to after authenticating. Copy the full address from your browser right after you finish.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That sign-in is for a different OmaPosti account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Posti tracking code.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Posti tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Posti tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Posti tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
